preserveSays.line: You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Rebecca Warren. Glazier. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Carpenter's square, Field suture kit, Mother's Ring, Grandfather's Rope, Reading Glasses. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. You heard it in the dark. Breathing. Not yours. It knew your name — it said it wrong, like it learned the shape of the sound but not what it meant.

🛡️ A person, maybe 60s catches you eyeing the bark plates — claw-scored, vine-laced. "...Want to actually SEE one?" They talk you through it — wide strips dried flat, laced overlapping like shingles, snug but not tight. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
You eat Dried meat and Trail mix (1400 kcal).
👂 Overheard — A person, maybe 50s: "If we rotate the watch, nobody pulls two nights running. Fair's fair."
You give A person, maybe 40s, with sun-creased eyes 3 portions of Dried beans, with the village watching. They look at you differently now.
You give Nina 3 portions of Dried beans, with the village watching. They look at you differently now.
The Dried beans was off. Your stomach knots. (-5 health)
The Dried beans was off. Your stomach knots. (-5 health)
👂 Overheard — A person, maybe 60s: "If we rotate the watch, nobody pulls two nights running. Fair's fair."
👂 Overheard — A person, maybe 50s: "If we rotate the watch, nobody pulls two nights running. Fair's fair."
You see smoke on the horizon. Emberhold — 8 people, 3 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 4 plants — 4 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
You see smoke on the horizon. Ashford — 8 people, 3 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 4 plants — 4 new to you. They've been here the whole time.

Travel 2 tiles to grove.
— Nut trees —
Mast crunches underfoot — last season's nuts, sprouting or rotting. The trees don't waste anything.
🍽️ Oliver weighs the day's basket against the pantry shelves and puts it down. "Enough. Carving bowls instead — we're down to the cracked ones."
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.

Travel 2 tiles to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Leaf litter, birdcall, the smell of rot becoming soil. The woods, being the woods.
The Dried beans was off. Your stomach knots. (-5 health)
The Dried beans was off. Your stomach knots. (-5 health)

Daniyar has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Aaliyah drew frothy white flower umbels on tall ridged stems along hedgerows in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.

👁 Wary. Ears always tracking. Get close before it knows you're there.
"So we made it OFFICIAL! The PARTY SYSTEM! Up to THREE companions! Formal! Tracked! With a UI! The audience can see your party composition now! Very important for the betting markets!"

Ivy looks at the pantry, then at the Codex, then at you. "We’re going to make it." Haven will survive — because someone learned the land, and wrote it down. One less thing to fear.
📓 Codex: you've SEEN Iron Stomach now. Reduce your risk of food poisoning. Push Through gives temporary protection from unsafe food.

The summer the oak came down across the driveway, Grandfather showed you the trucker's hitch and made you tie it until your fingers bled. You were eight. The tree moved.

🔥 The fire settles. Elijah has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Living Wire — I put it down today." "The water goes glass-still. A faint crackling, and the hairs on your arms lift." "The crackling fades. It slides backward into the black water, done spending itself — for now." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Daniyar breathes "So it bleeds." Oliver mutters "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
